title: Dinotopia books on their way
content: Good news for those of you who ordered a copy of the20th Anniversary Edition of Dinotopia. They all shipped out yesterday. The books are all signed with little drawings of dinosaurs in each one (Yes, Emily, you got your "Rainbowasaurus.")Here's the view from the clerk at our local post office yesterday afternoon.And for those who ordered the new Howard Pyle book, some of them have shipped already, and the rest will ship out this coming Monday. Those books are so popular that our supply ran out, so we're going directly to the source (The Delaware Art Museum) this week to get some more.If you live in the Mid-Atlantic states, please come to one of my upcoming lectures:November 10, MICA, BaltimoreNovember 12, Pyle Lecture (Delaware Art Museum)LINKSNew20th Anniversary Edition of DinotopiaNewHoward Pyle: American Master RediscoveredSee the YouTube video about how we mail off books
